material_findings: Generic event_id is already consumed by both frontend event replay identity and backend Mission View identity, so its least-disruptive contract belongs at the generic envelope layer rather than only life.planner.task_added.

BacklogItem can gain backward-compatible creation_stamp as an optional appended field, but exact recovery must fail closed on unstamped/conflicting same-ID rows and generic update should protect id/ts/creation_stamp.

Current front-door and daemon-boot semantic handoffs already mint stable Manager intent IDs; the shared Manager -> reset_stage_for_new_intent -> reset_stage_for_replacement_intent -> _set_stage path currently drops that lineage and stage_history has no transition_id.

Current web daemon start, immediate/scheduled upgrade, and operator-decision continue still directly re-enable continuous state and should refuse shortcut semantic enable while a handoff fence is active; explicit operator stop/off should cancel the fence.
